subject: Element acting as both input and output?

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Element acting as both input and output?
parts:
Im developing a widget, where a button summons a modal dialog box. In this box there will be some interaction back and forth between the client and the server. As the button summoning the modal box is the only permanent element for the widget, it would make sense for me that it acted both as an input and an output, using different data-attributes and different event triggers to keep the information separate. I can't seem to get it to work though, and was wondering whether there was some internal logic in the shiny implementation that prevented an element from having multiple roles?

best

Thomas
